summary: Cut at 6.6 (round 1: 5.0, round 2: 6.2, author: 6.9, Caiman: 7, ship: 7.5). Every gate is green and verified in report.json and template-verification.json, and the author's report matches the JSON. This is the best Corvus so far. In hero.png and shoulder.png one hooked-bill bird head now reads beside the stone. The fold at the arm tips is gone at its source (bypass_fair_deg 4). The 28 hackles and the side-face primaries are true-outline stamps and the best passage on the ring. It still fails the final round's test: face-300 and hero-300 must read as two ravens uncaptioned. At 300 px the face view shows a black cab flanked by ribbed, stepped blocks and two smooth bullet-nosed forms. It reads as a visor, a gun sight or a beetle, not as two ravens. The heads are the focal point and the weakest modelling. In head.png the skull's 'scallops' render as melted, smeared highlights with stair-stepped edges, not countable feathers. The eye is an irregular socket with a slash inside it, not a closed almond, so it is a poor face. The nasal bristles read as tally marks. The collet has 1.9-2.0 mm of plain wall on its long sides (collet_wall_mm sectors 3-4 and 11-12), and the neck feathers rising to it render as stacked ribbed plates, mechanical CAD. At the palm the tails are parallel rounded-end slabs that read as fork tines, not two splayed wedges. The side and reverse views show stair-stepped blocks at the arm crossings. Phoenix was cut at 7.0 with all gates green because it failed the glance test in its last round; Corvus scores lower on the same test, and there is no round left.
strengths: Every gate green at 1536×448, 768×320 and 384×192, recorded in report.json with θ, r, z for release; 0 DFM findings; template lifts with 0 design.set patches at 1.83 MB.
Plan composition holds: heads at the arm tips, bills pointing outward, tails meeting at the palm; a bypass as two creatures is distinct in the Bestiarium.
hero.png and shoulder.png: a hooked bill with a culmen highlight and a recognisable bird-head profile, much improved on round 2's egg dome.
The fold is removed at the source by a fenced, tested core change (C-B7, format 6), with no crease in shoulder.png or side.png.
28 throat hackles and 28 wing primaries struck as true-outline stamps; the shoulders in side.png and shoulder.png carry countable, shingled feathers at Caiman's density or better.
Sand slots are all named with bench treatment; the nape-dip slots are gone.

checklist.reason: Two ravens and Odin's onyx from collet to crossed tails; nothing off theme.

Hackles and primaries are crisp stamps, but the painted skull scallops (head.png) smear into melted highlights with stair-stepped edges, and the neck feathers round the collet (stones.png, face.png) render as stepped ribbed bars and dashes.

head.png and stones.png: the eye is an irregular socket with a slash/curl inside, reading as a rivet or screw hole, not a closed almond under a brow. The skull reads partly as a small human skull in stones.png.
Onyx in a made bezel collet, fully visible; stones reported 1 = previewed 1. Caveat: 1.9-2.0 mm of plain wall on the long sides.

checklist.item: Shoulder ornament not cut off toward the face
checklist.reason: Plumage and heads run into the collet foot; no ornament truncated at the face.

checklist.item: No flat, blocky or mechanical CAD
checklist.reason: Ribbed stacked blocks flank the collet (face.png, stones.png); tails are parallel rounded rectangles (palm.png); stair-stepped rectangular steps at the arm crossings (side.png bottom, reverse.png upper left and lower right).

checklist.item: Factory stock keeps its hard wall-to-face angles
checklist.reason: Procedural LowDome bypass, no factory stock; the band's walls and bore edges stay clean.

The only two-headed bypass; the long bill blades are unlike Arachne, Manticora, Fenrir, Harpyia, Kraken or Basiliscus. The black oval cab in a plain bezel echoes Arachne's onyx but the whole silhouette does not.

checklist.item: Reads as its subject at 300 px without caption
checklist.reason: hero-300: a bird head is plausible but could be a heron, a sword guard or a beak-shaped blade; face-300: a visor or sci-fi device with two bullet shapes. The author concedes face-300 does not say ravens. Two ravens are not counted uncaptioned.

checklist.item: Large, medium and small forms; density and legibility at least Caiman's
checklist.reason: Density meets Caiman on the shoulders. Legibility falls below it at the focal point: the heads and the collet surround are the least legible modelling on the ring, while Caiman's crown reads cleanly at 300 px.

punch_list.zone: Both skulls: layer 'Raven heads', Huginn θ 108-130°, Muninn θ 72-50° (rear 55-60% of each skull)
punch_list.change: Strike the skull contour feathers as stamps instead of painting them: 12-15 scalloped outlines per head, 0.9-1.0 mm across, 0.20-0.25 mm proud, pointing back along the ring, shingled so each steps down away from the crest. Keep only the forehead and bill glossy. Painted relief at this pitch is what smears into melted highlights.
punch_list.acceptance: head.png: at least 12 countable scallops with crisp closed outlines on the rear skull, no smear or stair-step on any edge, no polished patch wider than 2.5 mm except the forehead. Parting-monotone, release 0/0 at all three builds.

punch_list.zone: Eye stamps 'Huginn/Muninn, eye high/low', skull front third
punch_list.change: Replace the bench-cut pit with a struck almond: an orbit rim 1.4 × 0.9 mm, 0.15 mm proud, enclosing a flat-floored 1.0 × 0.6 mm almond 0.30 mm deep, long axis along the ring, pointed outer corner toward the bill; render it as finished. Drop the inner slash.
punch_list.acceptance: head.png: a closed almond with no curl, slash or tail, 1.0-1.1 × 0.6-0.7 mm against the skull; hero-300: a dark almond under a brow, not a rivet.

punch_list.zone: Crossing, θ 70-110°: layer 'Collet bed' and the neck feathers of 'Raven plumage'; seat 'Onyx, made collet'
punch_list.change: Remove the ribbed stacked blocks on the collet's short ends: strike the neck feathers as 10+ lanceolate stamps per side (1.4 × 0.5 mm, 0.25 mm proud) flowing from each nape into the collet foot. Cut the long-side plain wall from 1.9-2.0 mm to ≤ 0.8 mm by lowering the collet in its seat and raising feathered relief under it, fencing the overhang with a drafted skirt.
punch_list.acceptance: face.png and stones.png: no ribbed blocks, ladder rungs or dashes round the collet; ≥ 10 countable feather tips each side; collet_wall_mm ≤ 0.8 in every sector; face-300 shown uncaptioned is named as two birds.

punch_list.zone: Face view bills, Huginn θ 130-160°, Muninn θ 50-20°
punch_list.change: Give each bill a readable raven shape from above: taper the plan-view wedge from 2.9 mm at the root to a 0.5 mm point over the last 40% (not a parallel bullet), deepen the gape line to 0.15 mm, and replace the nasal-bristle tally marks with a feathered tuft 1.5 mm long lying forward over the bill root.
punch_list.acceptance: face-300: two tapered, hooked bills pointing to 3 and 9 o'clock, each ≥ 18 px, read as beaks, not bullets; no tally marks visible in hero.png.

punch_list.change: Splay each tail's five rectrices so the outer edges diverge 10-14° in total, widen the tips to 1.5 mm while holding the roots at 0.9 mm, and interleave the central tips rather than leaving a straight 0.3 mm gap.
punch_list.acceptance: palm.png: two opposed fan-shaped wedges, each with 5 rounded tips; no parallel slab reading; side.png shows no square block or notch at the palm.

punch_list.zone: Arm crossings under the collet, side faces near θ 60-120° and the bypass arm ends
punch_list.change: Fair the stair-stepped rectangular ledges at the crossing flanks (visible in side.png bottom and reverse.png upper left and lower right) with a 0.3 mm radius, or cover them with the primaries' roots.
punch_list.acceptance: side.png and reverse.png: no right-angled ledges or stepped blocks on the crossing flanks; watertight and 0 self-crossings at all builds.

punch_list.zone: Release sand slot at θ 19.6-19.8°, beak hook
punch_list.change: Open the hook's underside to ≥ 0.30 mm clearance against the other bird's back feathers.
punch_list.acceptance: sand_slots at 0.100 and 0.075 mm carry no 'beak' zone entry.
